2608.28467.title: Stranger, Fan, or Peer? A Systematic Study on the Role of Interlocutor in Persona-Based Dialogue Generation
2608.28467.paper_summary: Persona-based dialogue systems are usually conditioned on speaker biography, but dialogues involve at least two participants, and who has access to whose biography can vary across training, inference, and evaluation. Prior work often neglected these aspects, obscuring mechanisms that only appear when biography visibility is toggled separately across training, inference, and evaluation, a three-stage factorisation that prior work has largely treated as a single factor. We study this factorisation on a dataset of dialogues paired with speaker's biographies, varying whether the target and interlocutor speakers see each other's biographies during training and inference, and using an LLM as a judge to perform author identification. We find that (i) training-time visibility, more than inference-time visibility, determines whether models express persona traits through dialogue or fall back on copying biographical text (a known problem/phenomenon in persona-based generation); (ii) models trained with interlocutor-biography visibility copy less target-biographical text than models trained without it, while changing visibility only at inference time has a less consistent effect; and (iii) under asymmetric disclosure, where only the interlocutor sees the target biography, target content leaks into interlocutor turns more often, and dialogues containing such traces are easier for the judge to identify, especially when interlocutor turns are visible. These results suggest that biography leakage into generated turns is an artefact of how interlocutor visibility is configured across training and inference, and separating the three stages is necessary.
2608.28467.paper_summary_zh: 基於角色的對話系統通常以說話者的傳記為條件，但對話涉及至少兩個參與者，而誰能訪問誰的傳記在訓練、推理和評估中可能會有所不同。先前的研究通常忽略了這些方面，模糊了只有在訓練、推理和評估中單獨切換傳記可見性時才會出現的機制，這種三階段的因子化在先前的研究中大多被視為單一因子。我們在一個配對有說話者傳記的對話數據集上研究這種因子化，變化目標和對話者在訓練和推理期間是否能看到彼此的傳記，並使用大型語言模型作為判斷者進行作者識別。我們發現 (i) 訓練期間的可見性比推理期間的可見性更能決定模型是否通過對話表達角色特徵，或回退到複製傳記文本（這是基於角色生成中的一個已知問題/現象）；(ii) 在具有對話者傳記可見性的訓練下，模型複製的目標傳記文本比沒有此可見性的模型少，而僅在推理期間改變可見性則影響不一致；(iii) 在不對稱披露的情況下，只有對話者能看到目標傳記，目標內容更經常地洩漏到對話者的回合中，並且包含這種痕跡的對話對於判斷者來說更容易識別，特別是當對話者的回合可見時。這些結果表明，傳記洩漏到生成回合中是對話者可見性在訓練和推理中配置方式的一種產物，並且分離這三個階段是必要的。
